answers.q1: No. The panel just shows a generic auto-timestamp title '01:54 の会議' (01:54 meeting) with a recording indicator '録音中 00:02' — there is no calendar/event name, no app or platform tag (Zoom/Meet/Teams), and no indication of whether audio comes from the mic, system audio, or a call. It only tells me a recording is in progress, not what meeting or audio source it is.
answers.q2: Yes, and it explicitly says there is none: the footer line 'AI が見ている資料 — まだありません' (materials AI is looking at — none yet) directly answers whether there are documents in use right now.
answers.q3: Mostly one surface. There is a small floating dark pill toolbar (record/pause/comment/expand/more/stop) that visually overlaps the top edge of the main rounded white panel, which reads slightly like an overlay control rather than being fully fused into the panel — but it is not presented as a separate stacked window; it looks like one primary surface with a floating control strip docked to it.
answers.q4: The recording status ('録音中 00:02') together with the meeting title ('01:54 の会議') is the most prominent/important info, since everything else (transcript, decisions, to-dos, materials) is currently empty placeholder text waiting for content.
answers.q5: The meeting title '01:54 の会議' is unclear/uninformative — it's just a timestamp, not a real identifier of the meeting. There is also redundancy between the left panel's '聞いています…' (listening) and the right panel's empty transcript state — both communicate 'nothing has happened yet' in slightly different words. The four bottom action buttons (リアルタイム要約/質問する/決定事項/アクション) are grayed out with no visible explanation of why they're disabled or when they'll activate.

weaknesses.what: No source/platform/audio indicator; title is just an auto-generated timestamp, not a real meeting identity
weaknesses.fix: Show the actual meeting/event name (or app being captured, e.g. Zoom/Meet) and label the audio source (mic vs system audio)

weaknesses.what: Bottom action buttons are disabled with no explanation of why or when they become active
weaknesses.fix: Add a tooltip or subtle hint like '発話が始まると使えます' on hover/disabled state

weaknesses.what: Floating pill toolbar overlapping the panel top edge reads as a separate layer rather than fused chrome
weaknesses.fix: Dock the toolbar flush into the panel's top edge or visually merge its background with the card below
